summary: Validated (a) P0 Object Storage migration for tenant logo + content-worker asset uploads and (b) new Interactive Guided Tour with cached OpenAI TTS narration. All 5 backend pytest cases PASS (logo upload+GET roundtrip, content-worker asset upload+GET roundtrip, /api/tour/narration returns audio, TTS cache hit for same text, different url for different text). Frontend E2E on desktop (1920x1080) confirms: fresh-login auto-launch of guided-tour-card, all 7 steps advance correctly (Welcome->Overview->Fleet->Team->Reports->Announcements->Help), Finish button appears on last step, tour-prev/tour-mute-toggle/tour-close all work, closing sets qw_tour_done_<tenantId> in localStorage so reload does NOT re-auto-launch, and the header help-button ('Guided Tour') re-opens the tour manually. /api/tour/narration was hit 8 times during the flow with 0 red console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: GuidedTour tour has 7 steps (welcome + 6 targets). The review request narrative listed only 6; implementation matches its own list which is fine, but the initial 'welcome' step spotlights dashboard-title so keep buildTourSteps aligned if steps are added later.

Announcements tab loads a 'Loading messages...' overlay on reload that briefly blocks the header help-button click. Not a bug in this feature, but worth noting for future tour-reopen UX (consider disabling the loader modal when just navigating to the tab).
seed_data_creation: None - test uses a 1x1 PNG in-memory and unique narration text; content-worker asset prefixed TEST_ (not cleaned up, negligible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_tour_and_storage.py covers /api/tenant/upload-logo, /api/content-worker/assets/upload and /api/tour/narration incl. cache-hit assertions. Guided tour tenant id observed: f95fbe53-46cc-4f29-af6b-b9ea51758cbd (test-fleet). localStorage flag key format: qw_tour_done_<tenantId>. All 7 tour steps confirmed: welcome, overview, fleet, team, reports, announcements, help.
